normal_definition: LAM raw, non-faulty vehicles, the nine Finnish local days 2026-09-23 .. 10-01. Each day's hourly value first, then per day type and local hour the median across the days (min and max = the lowest and highest day). Volume counts a day without vehicles in that hour as 0. limit_kmh = the limit the governing sign showed on the most covered days of that type in that hour (a covered day: the sign's known state covers at least 30 minutes of the hour inside the 5-minute sign data, see sign_data; that day's value is the one shown longest; a tie in days goes to the value shown more minutes); limit_days_showing of limit_days_covered days showed it. share_over_limit is against that hour's limit.
